_why: The only agent that reads the showrunner's material, all of it, so a big context window and a big output budget. Cold: this is reading and sorting, not invention. Four files out (characters.md, world.md, story.md, facts.md), each its own write_artifact call. "references": "full" pastes every library file the round picked into the prompt; switch to "list" for a smaller-context model, and raise max_steps so it can read the files one by one.
_help: Committed. Provider and model are usually set in the UI (⚙ Model). null = the .env default. API keys never go here: they're saved per provider in secrets/keys.json.
